hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic fee overrides via beforeSwap lpFeeOverride, records tick observations via TruncGeoOracleMulti, and reinvests collected fees via a FullRangeLiquidityManager. On every swap, an additional undisclosed 0.10% fee (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) is unconditionally extracted from the input amount on top of any disclosed hook fee.
